target: max(0, arrival_delay_minutes), without upper clipping; completed non-diverted flights with observed arrival outcomes only
preprocessing: Train-only ordinal categories capped at 200; unknown categories -1; departure-time and weekday sine/cosine; nonnegative prediction clipping
research_check: Model RMSE <= 0.99 * training-mean baseline RMSE in both April and May; MAE versus median reported separately; no operational acceptance
policy: One prespecified model, no hyperparameter search. Freeze artifact, baselines and April evaluation before loading May rows. Evaluate May once; preserve failures and do not retune. Earlier project experiments already inspected this five-month release: this is a new model-specific temporal benchmark, not a globally untouched holdout. No deployment of duration inference.
